h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Panchkula

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Panchkula

items.pText: Panchkula was planned as a city of sectors at the foot of the Shivalik hills, beside Chandigarh, and nearly every sector has its own green park. Those parks are used by walkers in the morning and by families in the evening. More and more resident associations here want a children's playground and an outdoor gym in the same park.

FunPlay Systems makes both at our factory in Vasai, about 1,320 km from Panchkula, and sends them to Haryana by road. Our installation team or a dealer in the north installs them. Winters here are cold, summers are hot, and the monsoon is heavy, so we use galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic throughout. Send us a plan or photos of your park, and we will mark the playground, the gym and the safe play areas on one layout drawing.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Combining play and fitness in a sector park

c: Keep the children's area and the adult gym in separate zones, with a path or a planted strip between them. Gym machines have moving arms and pedals that small children should not wander into. Place the gym along the walking track, where most adults already are.
with a swing set beside it suits most sector parks. For adults, see our
. Benches between the two zones let parents keep an eye on both. On sloping ground near the hills, level the base before installation.

facts.label: Distance
facts.value: About 1,320 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Can one park in Panchkula have both a playground and an outdoor gym?
items.a: Yes. We plan them as separate zones on one layout, with space between the gym machines and the children's equipment.

items.q: How does the equipment cope with cold winters?
items.a: Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic handle the cold and damp of a north Indian winter well. Check the moving parts after the monsoon and again before winter.

items.q: Do you install in Panchkula, Chandigarh and nearby towns?
items.a: Yes. We dispatch by road from Vasai and install through our team or a dealer. Ambala and Patiala are covered the same way.
